description: This file defines a PHP class 'GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. The class implements string conversion, utilizes a trait for date/time helper methods, and manages a nullable DateTime object initialized from an optional string input. It provides a method to return a formatted date string.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that holds a date value, initialized from a string, and provides a formatted string representation using helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an optional date string, converting it to a DateTime object if provided.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string using helper methods, or null if no date is set.
